caption:
Allah knows what your soul whispers

Allah tells us He created man and knows what his soul whispers within him. The thoughts you keep to yourself are not hidden from Him.

Surah Qaaf 50:16

Turn tonight's overthinking into a quiet dua

#overthinking #allahknows #innerpeace #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
alt_text: We have created man and know what his soul whispers within him, for We are closer to him than his jugular vein (Surah Qaaf 50:16)
